data.title: 白金 · 烛影摇曳的榻上依偎
data.description: 【静谧深闺卧室·深夜】暖调香薰烛光在丝绒软榻旁静静摇曳。白金侧卧在深色床单上，单手支着下巴，冰蓝细吊带衬托出优美的腰线与背部线条。她指尖轻轻勾弄着你的衣襟，低声诉说着卸下刺客面具后的真实心事。
data.action: 侧卧倚枕伸手轻勾衣襟低语
data.lighting: 床头琥珀色香薰烛光跳动弱光
data.camera: 斜俯卧姿近景，目光与呼吸近距离聚焦
data.promptProse: Lying gracefully on side upon a deep velvet bed surrounded by soft candlelight, Platinum rests her cheek upon a silk pillow. Her slender fingers reach out delicately towards the viewer. The warm flickering amber candlelight glints along the curves of her ice-blue slip dress, capturing a quiet, deeply intimate moment of unspoken devotion.
